variant.title: Skyscraper Sudoku
variant.description: Each outside clue counts the buildings visible from that side of its row or column.
rule.skyscraper: Each outside clue counts the buildings visible from that side of its row or column.
rule_guide.title: Skyscraper Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: The digits 1 to 9 are building heights. A taller building hides every shorter building behind it.
rule_guide.item_2: Starting at the clue side, count a building only when it is taller than every building seen before it.
rule_guide.item_3: For a fixed left clue of 4, read 2 1 4 3 6 5 9 8 7 from left to right: 2 is visible, 1 is hidden by 2, then 4, 6 and 9 become new tallest buildings, for 4 visible buildings in total.
